exposure: mothers' and partners' high level of education
longer parental leave for the first 24 months
cohort: 813 couples in Sweden who completed a follow-up questionnaire 1 year after birth
finding: Longer parental leave, higher parental education level, higher maternal age, and non-instrumental vaginal birth were associated with longer duration of partial breastfeeding.
mod_finding: Non-instrumental vaginal birth was associated with longer duration of partial breastfeeding.
